idea-plugin.name: ComposeBridge
idea-plugin.description:
ComposeBridge: Real-Time Visual Editor & MCP Server for Jetpack Compose

ComposeBridge bridges the gap between running Android applications and your Kotlin source code. It enables developers and AI agents to inspect and modify UI elements—including colors, dimensions, and text—directly from the device screen, applying surgical changes straight to the source code via AST mutation without full project rebuilds.

🚀 Key Features

  • ⚡ Extreme Performance (60x Faster): Element analysis now takes ~0.15s thanks to In-Memory caching.
  • Real-Time On-Device Editing: Tap and adjust padding, dimensions, colors, and text directly on your connected device with instant Live Preview.
  • 🤖 AI-Ready via MCP (27 Tools): Built-in Model Context Protocol (MCP) server enables AI assistants (like Antigravity, Cursor, or Claude) to safely execute surgical patches.
  • Universal Design Scanner: Detects scattered hardcoded tokens (colors, strings, dimensions) across any Kotlin project, giving you an exact map of what needs refactoring.
  • Human-in-the-Loop Safety: Review all incoming changes in a side-by-side visual diff inside Android Studio.

⚠️ Honest Limitations & Experimental Features

We believe in absolute transparency. Please read our LIMITATIONS.md. Key warnings:

  • Experimental Remote Connection: Editing over the internet via Tailscale Funnel is experimental. It may disconnect due to network changes. USB connection is recommended for maximum stability.
  • Design System Mapping Required: If the tool cannot automatically find your Color, Dimension, or String files, it will safely pause and refuse to edit until you specify the file path in the "Discovery" tab. This prevents accidental code pollution.
  • KMP Support: Desktop (KMP) projects must use source modules instead of `.aar` binaries for the runtime.

Built for the Jetpack Compose Community. Actively developed.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
🛠️ Patch Release v1.1.7

  • Fixed Text Reference Path: Editing reference strings now correctly prioritizes AppStrings.kt.
  • M8ven.ai Optimizations: Added tool annotations (read-only, destructive) and improved descriptions for AI agents.

v1.1.6 - Architecture Decomposition, Dynamic QR, & Debranding

  • Modular Monolith Refactoring: Decomposed Agent, IDE plugin, and Server monoliths into clean, single-responsibility packages.
  • Dynamic QR Scanner: Host app reflection automatically finds local QrScannerActivity.
  • Full UI Localization: Complete English copy across all dialogs, toasts, and overlays.
  • P0 Fix: Color token re-edits in hex format reliably appear in the Changes tab.

v1.1.5 - Critical Rollback Fix (Hotfix)

  • CRLF False Positives Fixed: The server now normalizes line endings (CRLF/LF) before checksum comparisons, preventing false EXTERNAL_MODIFICATION_DETECTED warnings on Windows.
  • Stable Backup: .bridge.bak is now created only once on the first edit and never overwritten by subsequent edits, guaranteeing safe rollback to the true original state.
  • Journal Merge: Consecutive edits to the same token merge seamlessly without losing the original value.
  • Regression Tests: Added test_multi_edit_rollback.py with 100% passing tests (29/29).

v1.1.3 - AI Agent Integration (MCP) & Extreme Performance

  • AI Agent Ready (MCP): Model Context Protocol server exposing 27 deep-inspection and surgical AST refactoring tools for Antigravity, Cursor, and Claude Desktop.
  • 60x Faster Performance: Ultra-fast In-Memory Project Cache reducing element analysis latency from 8.9s to ~0.15s (zero scandir calls).
  • Full Toolbar & Sync: Restored 4-icon visual toolbar and instant sync button integration.
  • Human-in-the-Loop Diff: Side-by-side review of AI & on-device changes inside Android Studio before applying.

v1.1.2 - Complete Refactoring & Critical Fixes

  • Architectural Refactoring: Split monolithic files into 25+ specialized modules.
  • Text Editing Fixed: Resolved relative imports and AppStrings resolution issues.
  • Multi-Registry Dimensions: Fixed padding edits on complex lines.
  • Release Builds: Added composebridge-runtime for flawless assembleRelease.
